p.src: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song.

en: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song.

p.src: 1  In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

en: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
u.src: 1  In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

p.src: 2  His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

en: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.
u.src: 2  His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

p.src: 3  There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

en: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
u.src: 3  There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

p.src: 4  Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

en: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
u.src: 4  Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

p.src: 5  Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

en: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
u.src: 5  Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

p.src: 6  At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

en: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
u.src: 6  At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

p.src: 7  You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

en: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
u.src: 7  You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

p.src: 8  You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

en: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
u.src: 8  You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

p.src: 9  when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

en: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
u.src: 9  when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

p.src: 10  Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

en: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
u.src: 10  Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

p.src: 11  Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

en: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
u.src: 11  Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

p.src: 12  He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

en: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
u.src: 12  He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
